scope: All three playable Sky Lagoon screens; source artwork identity and paths preserved. Gameplay animation, not cinematic delivery.
art_gap: Existing isolated lower bough and scattered added tufts fail whole-scene motion coverage. Whole arrival tree and broad grass/cloud/shrub separation are needed.

direction.arrival: Whole foreground conifer with coordinated branch tiers and fixed planted trunk base; two shrub banks; broad foreground grass; multiple existing cloud masses.
direction.meadow: Broad grass patches on both sides of preserved path, planted huckleberry groups in foreground and middle distance, separate cloud masses.
direction.castle: Grass and shrubs on banks and right of descending path; whole conifer; cloud masses; retain contact-driven Aseprite bridge and improve water beyond opacity-only highlights.

whole_tree.method: Layered rest source and direct Aseprite cels; authored tier flex, branch overlap and delayed tip settling; no isolated moving rectangle.

grass.method: Broad irregular authored patches, fixed soil and path edges; distinguish blade bend from moving the ground.

background_shrubs.method: Separate coherent foliage crowns with stable root and branch structure; smaller displacement in distant depth.

clouds.method: Separate existing complete cloud masses, heal sky behind, subtle contour evolution with slow bounded drift; no moving crop including mountains.

bridge.method: Keep Aseprite contact sequence and exact route; review deformation amplitude at gameplay size.

water.method: Directional painted ripple evolution and local reflection displacement; fixed shoreline, contact ripple separate.

rejection_checks: Any single twitching patch attached to a frozen tree
Any duplicated source object remaining painted behind a moving card
Exposed holes, rectangular seams, texture boiling or floating roots
Only scattered new grass tufts while the main grassy region stays frozen
One moving cloud while the visible cloud field is otherwise untreated
Animation visible only with magnification or difference images
Path obstruction, castle silhouette drift, repetitive clone planting
Whole scene moving in synchrony or competing with Roshan
evidence_required: Rest vs original composite at native size
Full-object all-frame contact sheets with source bounds and pivots
Combined real-time clips for all three stages at gameplay size
Static/animated A-B with exact camera and lighting
Loop boundary and maximum-displacement edge review
Pause, teardown, rollback, bridge travel and save regression
Mobile renderer and target-device performance separately
rollout: New versioned sources first; original and rejected draft retained. Do not silently replace runtime textures until source and combined scene review establish improvement.
